basis: Developmental delay and skeletal malformations define the syndrome; dermatitis and sparse scalp hair occur in 30-79%.
Pilocytic astrocytoma arising in the cerebellum.
Inherited bile acid homeostasis disorder causing progressive cholestasis and liver failure; prolonged coagulation reflects hepatic dysfunction.
Emery-Dreifuss dystrophy comprises skeletal myopathy and characteristic cardiac disease; SYNE2-specific cardiac frequency is uncertain. Respiratory weakness does not establish lung damage.
Unilateral hearing loss with delayed endolymphatic hydrops is an inner-ear disorder.
Benign bone-forming tumor arising in the middle ear.
Neurodevelopmental disorder with seizures; hearing impairment occurs in 4/9 and visual impairment in 3/9. Estimates are based on small cohorts.
Embryonal carcinoma arising in the central nervous system.
Autoimmune-associated restrictive pulmonary syndrome with persistent loss of lung volume and ventilatory function.
Cataracts, microphthalmia, skin atrophy and skeletal abnormalities define the syndrome; dental abnormalities occur in 80-99%. Intellectual disability is <30%.
Deficient anterior pituitary hormone secretion; pituitary location alone does not establish neurologic damage.
USH2A-associated retinal degeneration; this concept denotes retinitis pigmentosa, without evidence establishing syndromic hearing loss.
Progressive sensorineural hearing impairment; neural deafness alone does not establish additional neurologic disease.
Defined by digital skeletal malformations and recurrent patellar dislocation; neurologic impairment is not established as a major feature.
ALPK1 autoinflammatory syndrome with optic neuropathy and splenomegaly/pancytopenia (12/14); sweat dysfunction causes anhidrosis in 13/13. Migraine alone adds no neurologic damage.
Inborn amino acid metabolism disorder; no additional organ damage is established across this metabolic category.
Genetically heterogeneous epilepsy category; additional organ findings belong to individual syndromes.
Skeletal dysplasia spectrum; dental abnormalities belong to the odontochondrodysplasia subtype and are not established across the group.
Predominantly a peritoneal mesothelial tumor, assigned to the gastrointestinal axis; pleural tumors are less common primary-site variants, not additional organ involvement.
Congenital intestinal transport, absorptive or epithelial dysfunction; metabolic and immune mechanisms are subtype-specific.
Optic nerve/visual pathway glioma; the parent specifies optic nerve origin while the definition includes the intracranial optic tract.
Leiomyosarcoma arising in the heart; smooth muscle histology does not imply skeletal muscle disease or establish an infectious cause.
Thyroid hormone resistance; skeletal maturation delay and learning disability each occur in 30-79%. Tachycardia alone is not damage; recurrent otitis is a separate disease.
Deficient hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal hormone signaling; anosmia and intellectual disability are occasional (5-29%).
IKBKG immunodeficiency with intrinsic dental abnormalities: conical teeth in 4/5 and hypodontia in 1/3. Pneumonia and mycobacterial infections are separately diagnosed infections.
